svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-17
svg.desc: Mounted camera collision and GAS lifetime hardening.
svg.text: 2026-07-17 - Mounted camera and GAS lifetime hardening
main | 2 commits: 703e825, 3d3ed05
Daily job
Make mounted presentation and ability/effect lifetime safer without mixing their ownership concerns.
Broom mesh collision, effect actor cleanup, beam lifetime, damage cleanup, attributes, and auto-test lifetime changed.
BEFORE
Mounted view and lifetime hazards
Broom mesh could occlude the camera.
Effect/ability cleanup paths were fragile.
Beam and test objects could outlive their use.
Different failure classes shared one symptom:
mounted gameplay did not finish cleanly.
AFTER
Camera channel and object lifetime are explicit
Broom mesh ignores the camera collision channel for third-person mounted view.
Effect actors, beam spell state, damage cleanup, attributes, and auto-tests are hardened.
Unsafe or obsolete cleanup paths are removed or made lifetime-aware.
Debug camera collision separately from GAS object lifetime.
Important guard
Camera collision is a mesh-channel problem.
Ability lifetime is an object cleanup problem.
Do not diagnose one as the other.
Validation / newcomer path
Read broom collision settings with GAS cleanup code.
The monthly map is the detailed source; this card
separates the two debugging branches.
